question: Marked price of an article is 150 percent of the value of discount. Marked price is what percent of the selling price?
solution:
Marked price = 150% of discount

Discount = Marked price - Selling price

**Formula Used:**

Discount = Marked price × (Discount% ÷ 100)

Marked price = Selling price × (Marked price% ÷ 100)
